title: vtenext before 25.02.2 contains a cross-site request forgery protection bypass because csrf_check() in…
description: vtenext versions before 25.02.2 have a vulnerability where the CSRF protection mechanism can be bypassed. The function csrf_check() in include/utils/VteCsrf.php does not validate the __csrf_token for non-POST requests, allowing attackers to trick logged-in users into executing state-changing GET requests. This can lead to unauthorized actions performed with the user's privileges.
